description: R8 P0-3: srv-Yes extrapolation estimators, CI, flip table, and propagation to v7 classification

inputs.stratification: production BH FDR sig (200) vs non-sig (200); flip rates below use baseline-rerun significance for reviewer parity and production strata for design-based weighting

a_ratio_method_current_manuscript.statistical_property: Assumes a single multiplicative factor homogeneous across strata. Contradicted by own data (flip-out 22.7% in sig layer vs flip-in 5.0% in nonsig layer; heterogeneity chi2=213.8, p=2.05e-48). Because the 50/50 sample over-weights the sig stratum relative to the 34/66 universe, and the sig stratum is where srv erodes signal multiplicatively, the pooled ratio is too small -> DOWNWARD biased here (28.0% < 29.6%).

b_stratified_weighting_recommended.formula: w_sig x P(sig_srv|prod-sig stratum) + w_nonsig x P(sig_srv|prod-nonsig stratum), w=(1690,3284)/4974
b_stratified_weighting_recommended.statistical_property: Design-based (post-stratified / Horvitz-Thompson type) estimator: unbiased under stratified random sampling with known sampling fractions; no homogeneity assumption. RECOMMENDED primary estimator.

c_absolute_difference.statistical_property: Assumes a single additive effect homogeneous across strata. The common-frame difference (8.65pp on the 50/50 sample) over-weights the sig stratum where the absolute loss is largest (22.7pp loss vs 5.0pp gain), overstating the universe-level reduction (true stratified loss ~4.4pp) -> DOWNWARD biased, the most biased of the three (25.3% < 28.0% < 29.6%).

ci_for_recommended_estimator.method: stratified percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples of the 393 common genes within production strata, seed 20260924
ci_for_recommended_estimator.note: CI covers sampling uncertainty of the srv-Yes reruns only; universe composition (34.0%/66.0%) is the full-production-run quantity, treated as fixed.

propagation_to_classification.method: v7 rule (g>r+0.15 & sig -> GD; r>g+0.15 & !sig -> RD; r>g+0.15 & sig & g>0.3 -> dual; else neutral; RELAX-relaxed modifier) re-applied to the 393 common genes with sig := sig_srv; stratum x class transition probabilities extrapolated to the 4,974-gene universe; RELAX/Selectome/GDS/RDS inputs held fixed (no srv-RELAX rerun available).

gd_srv_sensitive_in_sample.note: GD genes losing BUSTED significance under srv Yes drop out of GD (to neutral per v7 rule)

propagation_to_classification.rd_logic_chain: RD requires NOT significant. srv Yes has two opposing flows: (i) flip-IN genes (gain significance) leave RD -> become dual-driven (if g>0.3) or neutral; (ii) flip-OUT genes (lose significance) with r>g+0.15 newly enter RD (mainly from dual-driven and from sig-neutral genes). Net effect estimated via transition matrix above.
